sources.source_name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand — OCR held at 2.75%, 28 October 2026
sources.purpose: Official MPC vote split and forward guidance after unexpected policy hold
sources.reliability_limits: Policy vote and forecast are official; intraday FX market reaction must be sourced separately; future tightening is conditional, not a guaranteed decision

learnings.title: Central-bank hold is not automatically dovish: verify vote split and conditional guidance
learnings.claim: On 28 October 2026 RBNZ held OCR at 2.75% by a 4–3 vote; three members favoured a 25bp increase. The MPC said further tightening likely but conditional on the outlook; September CPI was 3.7%, December-quarter inflation forecast 4.4%.
learnings.decision: FINANCE_CENTRAL_BANK_HOLD_VOTE_SPLIT_GATE: On a surprising hold, report official policy level, vote tally, dissent direction, conditional forward guidance, and release date separately. Do not label the hold an unconditional easing/dovish pivot or assert the next hike as certain. Keep currency first reaction separate from later session close.
learnings.next_measurement: On the next split MPC vote, compare official vote and conditional guidance to intraday FX and next-session closing observations before classifying policy surprise.
fallback_history: If official vote tally unavailable, report policy action only and mark split N/A; if FX close unavailable, label initial reaction only.
